0022600220.text: The San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) are on an eight-game winning streak and have gone 4-0 on the road, while the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Spurs swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently winning 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026. San Antonio is missing Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Chicago's Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions.
